Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a laboratory lesson booking by a teacher or maintenance slot.

date.description: The date of the booking in YYYY-MM-DD format.

lessonNumber.description: Lesson period index (1 to 5 for matutino, 1 to 3 for vespertino).

teacherName.description: Name of the reserving teacher or department.

activityDescription.description: Short description of the pedagogical activity.

isMaintenance.description: Whether the slot is blocked for technical lab maintenance.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the booking was created.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Global collection of all laboratory bookings accessible to school teachers and coordinator.
